name: webdata-tools-mcp
description: Twelve web-data tools for agents: jobs, hiring signals, news, reviews, Reddit, contacts, real estate, Shopify, exhibitors, events.
long_description: Runs ready-made Apify Actors (published by tacps126) on your own Apify account and returns clean JSON. Covers job postings from career pages, LinkedIn and Indeed, hiring signals, Google News, Trustpilot and app-store reviews, Reddit mentions, website contact details, German property listings, Shopify products, trade-show exhibitor lists and upcoming events. You pay Apify per result (about $1-3 per 1,000); every call has a spend cap.

tools.name: search_google_news
tools.description: Search Google News (any language and country) and return articles with the publisher's real article URL, publisher, date and related coverage. Supports Google operators ("exact phrase", -exclude, OR, intitle:) and site filters.

tools.name: find_hiring_companies
tools.description: Buying-intent signal: which companies are hiring for the roles you care about, how many roles, how fresh, and seniority/locations. Give target accounts (their jobs-page URLs on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor) and/or job-search phrases to discover companies.

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: All open jobs from company career pages in one normalized format (title, company, location, remote/hybrid, seniority, salary, apply URL, posted date). Paste career-page URLs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday, Personio or Teamtailor; the board type is detected automatically.

tools.name: search_indeed_jobs
tools.description: Search Indeed job listings by keyword and location in 9 countries (us, uk, ca, au, ie, de, fr, nl, sg): title, company, location, salary, job type, benefits, skills and apply link.

tools.name: search_naukri_jobs
tools.description: Jobs from Naukri.com, India's largest job board, by keyword and city: title, company, AmbitionBox rating, experience range in years, skills, and (with details) the full description, salary in rupees, industry, department and qualifications.

tools.name: get_trustpilot_reviews
tools.description: Trustpilot reviews for one or more companies (rating, title, text, reviewer, country, date, company reply) plus the company's TrustScore and review counts. Filter by stars, language, verified and date period.

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play in one dataset: rating, text, author, date, app version, developer reply, sentiment. Mix both stores and several countries.

tools.name: search_reddit
tools.description: Reddit posts (and optionally comments) by keyword, subreddit or user: title, text, author, subreddit, score, links and dates. Good for brand and topic monitoring.

tools.name: find_website_contacts
tools.description: Finds business emails, phone numbers, addresses and social profiles (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) on any list of websites; it visits the contact and about pages itself. Use only for lawful business outreach (GDPR / CAN-SPAM).

tools.name: search_german_property_listings
tools.description: Apartments and houses for rent or sale in Germany or Austria: price, rent, area, rooms, address with coordinates, energy class, features, agent, photos and dates. Not Switzerland.

tools.name: get_shopify_products
tools.description: Products from any Shopify store: prices, sale prices, discounts, stock, variants, SKUs, images and descriptions. Whole stores, collections or single products. Useful for price and stock monitoring.

tools.name: get_trade_show_exhibitors
tools.description: Exhibitor lists of trade shows as B2B leads: company, booth and hall, email, phone, website, address, socials and categories. 91 built-in shows (e.g. medica, sema-show, nab-show, fabtech, ish, automechanika, wtm-london, orgatec, eurotier, wine-paris, biofach) or any exhibitor-list link or show homepage on Messe Frankfurt, Messe Düsseldorf, Koelnmesse, NürnbergMesse, Newfront/ExpoPlatform, RX, Map Your Show, a2z / A2Z Connect, Swapcard or Corussoft; the link's own show and year are used. Contact coverage depends on what the organiser publishes.

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Upcoming events by topic and city, or from Luma / Eventbrite / Meetup links (or any page with schema.org events): name, dates, venue with address and coordinates, organiser, hosts, ticket prices, free/sold-out and attendee count, in one format. Use for event prospecting, sponsorships and community research.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: From Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations. Actors run on your account.

max_charge_usd.title: Maximum spend per tool call (USD)
max_charge_usd.description: Apify stops a run when this is reached.

timeout_secs.title: Maximum wait per tool call (seconds)
timeout_secs.description: How long one call may run before it is stopped (30 to 300).
